level_one.title: Righteous Assault
level_one.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.
level_one.short_description: Reduce Sacred Sweep cooldown by hitting Heroes
level_one.raw_description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by <c val="#TooltipNumbers">3</c> seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

level_four.title: Heavy Burden
level_four.description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.  Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.
level_four.raw_description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by <c val="#TooltipNumbers">20%</c> for <c val="#TooltipNumbers">2.5</c> seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.<n/><n/><c val="#AbilityPassive">Passive: </c>Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by <c val="#TooltipNumbers">0.25</c> seconds.

level_seven.title: Glimmer of Hope
level_seven.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.
level_seven.short_description: Regen Globes reduce Ray of Heaven energy cost
level_seven.raw_description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by <c val="#TooltipNumbers">75%</c>.

level_ten.title: Crystal Aegis
level_ten.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.
level_ten.short_description: Put an allied Hero into a Stasis crystal that explodes
level_ten.raw_description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for <c val="#TooltipNumbers">2</c> seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals <c val="#TooltipNumbers">255</c><c val="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage to all nearby enemies.

level_thirteen.title: Piercing Lash
level_thirteen.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.
level_thirteen.short_description: Detainment Strike hits all enemy Heroes in a line
level_thirteen.raw_description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by <c val="#TooltipNumbers">2</c> seconds for each Hero hit.

level_one.title: Anchored Core
level_one.description: Dark Heart Ritual: +25% Radius +25% Duration  Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage.
level_one.short_description: Increase duration and radius of the Dark Heart
level_one.raw_description: Dark Heart Ritual:<n/><c val="#TooltipGreen">+25%</c> Radius<n/><c val="#TooltipGreen">+25%</c> Duration<n/><n/>Dark Heart's damage bounces <c val="#TooltipNumbers">2</c> times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing <c val="#TooltipNumbers">25</c><c val="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage.

level_four.title: Dark Barrier
level_four.description: Each time the Dark Heart damages an enemy Hero, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.
level_four.short_description: Gain a Shield whenever the Dark Heart damages an enemy Hero
level_four.raw_description: Each time the Dark Heart damages an enemy Hero, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to <c val="#TooltipNumbers">2%</c> of her maximum Health, up to <c val="#TooltipNumbers">10%</c>.

level_seven.title: Toxic Mark
level_seven.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration  Heroes affliced with Shadow Mark have their Armor reduced by 10 and take damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health every second.
level_seven.short_description: Shadow Mark affliction deals damage over time
level_seven.raw_description: <c val="#TooltipGreen">+1s</c> Shadow Mark Duration<n/><n/>Heroes affliced with Shadow Mark have their Armor reduced by <s val="StandardTooltipDetails">10</s> and take damage equal to <c val="#TooltipNumbers">1%</c> of their maximum Health every second.

level_ten.title: Void Eruption
level_ten.description: Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.  Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 90 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.  When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.  Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 166 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).  Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.
level_ten.short_description: Channel a growing orb that deals damage in its path
level_ten.raw_description: Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after <c val="#TooltipNumbers">2</c> seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.<n/><n/>Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take <c val="#TooltipNumbers">90</c><c val="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage and are Blinded for <s val="StandardTooltipDetails">1</s> second.<n/><n/>When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing <c val="#TooltipNumbers">400</c><c val="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage.<n/><n/>Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to <c val="#TooltipNumbers">166</c><c val="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> and its explosion damage up to <c val="#TooltipNumbers">700</c><c val="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c>.<n/><n/><s val="TooltipSubscript">Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.</s>

level_thirteen.title: Dark Heart's Protection
level_thirteen.description: Detonating the Dark Heart now Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.  Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.
level_thirteen.short_description: Xal'atath and Allies receive Spell Armor while near the Dark Heart
level_thirteen.raw_description: Detonating the Dark Heart now Silences enemies inside its radius for <c val="#TooltipNumbers">1</c> second.<n/><n/>Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain <c val="#TooltipNumbers">30</c> Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

level_sixteen.title: Fractured Reality
level_sixteen.description: +25% Void Volley Projectile Damage  Void Volley's projectiles leave behind a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.
